packet.title: Comparisons and arithmetic (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements operators: numeric promotion, arithmetic overflowing into libmpdec, temporal arithmetic, and value and general comparisons with the untypedAtomic rules.

body.p: After , . Owns src/operator.c, src/operator_compare.c, src/operator_internal.h, tests/operator_test.c. Numeric promotion, arithmetic with integer overflow into libmpdec, value and general comparisons with untypedAtomic rules. Done when those slice lines pass as unit cases. Spec: XPath 4.0 "Arithmetic Expressions", "Comparison Expressions". Done 2026-10-16 (, ): also src/operator_temporal.c, GNode comparisons; P2 and P3 accepted.
